node.title: Rate-half MCA whole-line global-core cancellation router
node.closure: exact line-global cancellation and identity-fiber structural router
node.statement: For any finite declared selected set of support-wise MCA-bad slopes on one Reed-Solomon received line, either all selected explanations are globally affine or the intersection C_* of all selected maximal agreement supports has size below k and can be cancelled once from the entire line. The resulting unique shortened row preserves every slope, actual same-support noncontainment, and the invariants m-k,n-k,n-m; the slope map is the identity with fiber one, so no sum over record-local cores occurs. This node makes no shortened-family payment claim; the former direction-separated 3<=s<=13 gate is retracted and corrected compilers consume the single residual separately.
